name: Filter list
description: Keep only the array elements that match your conditions — e.g. only delayed flights, only adult passengers. Outputs the matching subset (not a pass/fail gate). Use it to filter the right list before a Join, or to filter the result after.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The list to filter, e.g. $.flights. Leave blank to use the upstream node's output.

params.name: field
params.description: The field on each element to test, e.g. status.
